name: voice-summary
description: Speaks a one-sentence summary of each long turn when it ends.

enabled.title: Voice summary: enabled
enabled.description: Speak a short summary when a turn ends.

minSeconds.title: Voice summary: minimum seconds
minSeconds.description: Turns shorter than this many seconds stay silent. 0 speaks every turn.

language.title: Voice summary: language
language.description: Language of the spoken summary. Pick the one your voice reads.

voice.title: Voice summary: system voice
voice.description: Exact name of a system voice, as `say -v '?'` lists it. Empty uses the system default.

model.title: Voice summary: model
model.description: Model alias or id that writes the summary.

elevenLabsVoiceId.title: Voice summary: ElevenLabs voice ID
elevenLabsVoiceId.description: When set, and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is in the environment, ElevenLabs speaks the summary. Empty keeps the system voice.

elevenLabsModel.title: Voice summary: ElevenLabs model
elevenLabsModel.description: ElevenLabs model id. eleven_v4_turbo is fast and half the price per character; eleven_v4 and eleven_multilingual_v2 cost the full price.
